name: magic-ui-shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
description: A button with an animated shimmer effect that slides continuously from left to right using a conic-gradient background.
use_when: You want an animated CTA that draws visual attention.
avoid_when: When you need a static, minimal button.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Shimmer is visual only. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
